verdicts.reason: A scrambles the reading order: 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' drops to the bottom, the tagline sits under the date and the venue sits under the URL. It also puts the large grey missing-asset placeholder and the legal text in the top-centre spot, shrinks the logo to a speck, lets the oversized phone take over the left side, and turns the RSVP CTA into a pill the same size as the badges. B at least keeps the headline dominant on the left and the logo on its circle, but it has clear breaks: the tagline is squeezed into a 4-line column, 'Saturday 21 June' leaves 'June' orphaned, the phone is tiny, RSVP is again just one of four equal pills, and the legal text and the large placeholder sit loose in the middle.
